helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Propylphenidate binds to the norepinephrine transporter in human embryonic kidney cells with an affinity similar to that of isopropylphenidate and ethylphenidate. However, its binding affinity for the dopamine transporter is 4 times lower, making it one of the methylphenidate analogues with the weakest affinity for DAT. On drug user forums, its subjective effects are described as very mild.

uses.text: It was banned in the UK as a Temporary Class Drug from April 2015 following its unapproved sale as a designer drug.
